ValidationRule.description: For Broker Opportunities, the Broker Commission must be equal to the Broker Commission on the Opportunity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Opportunity__r.RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty' && RecordType.Name = 'Broker/Internal' && Payee_Bank_Account__r.Name <> 'National Funding' && Payee_Bank_Account__r.Name <> 'BOFI FEDERAL BANK' && Opportunity__r.Broker_Commission__c <> Amount__c
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Amount must be equal to the Broker Commission field on the Opportunity, for Broker WC Opptortunities.
